resources.string: Camera and ISP Tweaks for Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G: 4K 60FPS, 150Mbps Bitrate, Pro RAW (DNG), 50MP Normal Photo, Leica Profiles, Dual Video, Long Exposure, Thermal Bypass.
Unlocks crystal clear 4K video recording up to 60 frames per second on both the main and selfie cameras.
Increases video recording bitrate to 150 Mbps for sharper, blur-free details.
Unlocks uncompressed 12.5MP native Bayer RAW (DNG) photos in Pro Mode without sharpening or noise reduction.
Adds Leica Authentic and Leica Vibrant color profiles and the original Leica watermark.
Record video using the front selfie and rear main cameras simultaneously in split-screen.
Extends manual shutter exposure up to 60 seconds for night sky and light painting.
Prevents the camera from stopping video or closing automatically when warm.
Captures full 50-megapixel pictures in standard Photo mode without green tint.
Records flat, natural video in Pro mode with extra shadow and highlight detail for color grading.
Shoots videos in wide theatrical cinema aspect ratio with cinematic black bars.
Shows your script right on screen while recording video so you can speak naturally.
Outlines what is in focus with bright highlights and shows zebra stripes over very bright areas.
Automatically tracks and locks continuous focus on eyes, faces, and moving subjects in photos and videos.
Adds a camera mode that automatically straightens documents, papers, and IDs to look like clean scans.
Lets you use Bluetooth earbuds as your recording microphone and zooms audio towards what you zoom into.

Xiaomi software restricts many camera capabilities on mid-range devices. This module bypasses these artificial restrictions by directly hooking into the Xiaomi Camera application at runtime.\n\nEnabling the module allows you to cleanly toggle hidden features without modifying your system files. You can turn on each feature below, and a toast will confirm if the hook was successful when the Camera app opens.
